snippet.title: The Internal – Corporate Souls Roguelike | Official OPEN BETA Trailer
snippet.description:
The Internal Open Beta coming to Steam on 12 March 2026. Wishlist now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3638650/The_Internal/

Fight your mutated co-workers trapped inside a broken corporate simulation. Climb the corporate ladder through parries and perfect dodges. When the clock hits 1700, there are no second chances.
